div.head: Hn com 2.1
div.ab: Ego enim, quando uoluero, faciam ea satis summonere propter mea dominica necessaria ad uoluntatem meam.
Ego enim, quando voluero, faciam ea satis summonere propter mea dominica necessaria ad voluntatem meam.
For I, when I so desire, shall have them summoned, in accordance with my will, a sufficient number of times, in order to transact the business pertaining to the crown.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 286–287 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text added from Gesetze I p. 524, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)

dominicus: ‘royal, sovereign’ (Stubbs), eigen der Krone selbst, im Ggs. zu den Einkünften, die sie dem Sheriff verpachtet hat. Die Staatssteuer hing zusammen mit willkürlich von der Krone vorgeladenen Versammlungen, laut Ann. Agsax. 1124: ‘Recht schweres Jahr war es; wer etwas hatte, dem ward es fortgenommen durch harte Steuern und harte motes’

dominicus: ‘royal, sovereign’ (Stubbs), belonging to the Crown itself, in contrast to the revenues it has farmed out to the sheriff. State taxation was connected with assemblies summoned at will by the Crown, according to Ann. Agsax. 1124: ‘It was a very hard year; whoever had anything had it taken from him by harsh taxes and harsh motes’
